title: Attribution Record
description: attribution-record/v1 (stack ADR-079, roster-keeper spec §5.5). Append-only rows in <repo>/.claude/sweep/attributions.jsonl, foreign-keyed by finding_id. Each pipeline stage appends a complete new record, never a patch; readers take the highest seq per finding_id. Cross-record invariants (R1/R2, the none_reason rule, the production-data fence) are enforced by roster-keeper.sh validate, fail-closed.

responsible_agent_candidates.description: Copied from the ownership map cell at stamp time; [] is legal (a known-gap or unset-surface cell).

surface_source.description: Never 'roster-keeper' — the keeper may not classify a missing surface (spec §3).

responsible_agent.description: One of the stamped candidates, or the literal 'none', or null (not yet attributed / R2-invalidated).

none_reason.description: Required iff responsible_agent == 'none'. Only 'unowned' counts toward the new-agent bar.

attributed_by.description: roster-keeper | human | cross-family:<model>. Written at answer time, never reconstructed (R1).

adjudication_blind.description: false ⇒ the record cannot render (R3). Set by the adjudication step only.

roster_action_ref.description: Check ID, agent name, or proposal path. Null iff roster_action is 'none' or null.
